name: khuym
description: Khuym: independent skills for prompting, goals, research, execution, Git, and tldraw automation

interface.shortDescription: Portable skills for stronger work and diagrams
interface.longDescription: Six independent skills: five improve prompting, goals, research, sequencing, and Git commits; one automates tldraw through its local Canvas API. No onboarding workflow or repository state machine is required.
defaultPrompt: Improve this rough prompt; if it is a goal, grill me until success and stop conditions are verifiable.
Research this unfamiliar feature, then sequence the recommendation by dependency and risk.
Group the current working tree into logical commits and push it.
